itchGames.title: Haberdashery - Endless Arcade Runner
itchGames.shortDescription: Run for your little Sheep life and look dashing doing it!
itchGames.descriptionMd:
Run for your little Sheep life and look dashing doing it! Collect hat boxes and coins, whilst cycling through a myriad of game mechanics, thrown out at a rapid fire pace.

In this challenging, fast-paced, endless runner the goal is to avoid rocks, trees, spike pits, and mines, while collecting all your treasures. Be careful not to end up as dragon food though!

Ever wanted to be a Viking? Or maybe just a Wizard? How about good ol' Uncle Sam, merica'! Well now you can! With over 30 hats to unlock, we're sure there's something for everyone, in this hilarious and outrageous game.

Collect coins, buy hats, avoid that dragon, play the slots, or maybe try the arcade! Whatever you prefer, this game will keep you coming back for more, with laughs every time!

Haberdashery is produced by Luna Wolf Studios, in collaboration with Geek Monster Games and is intended to be free for all to play! As a two man team we are strongly passionate about this project, and our goal is for everyone to have as much fun playing it as we did making it!

[https://www.newgrounds.com/portal/view/658511](https://www.newgrounds.com/portal/view/658511)

FEATURES:

-Random environment every game!

-30 unlockable Hats!

-Different gameplay with every Hat!

-Extra Arcade modes to unlock and play!

-Leaderboards and Achievements to compete with friends

-Laughs for days!

P.S. Under 'Options' use Promo Code: "SheepInHats" to help get your 'Haberdashery' started.

Like us on FaceBook:

[https://www.facebook.com/HaberdasheryGame/](https://www.facebook.com/HaberdasheryGame/)

Follow us on Twitter:

[https://twitter.com/sheepinhats](https://twitter.com/sheepinhats)

itchGames.title: ParaLily
itchGames.shortDescription: A Strange Journey Through Parallel Universes.
itchGames.descriptionMd:
Help Lily survive the paranormal and rescue a friend, on her strange journey through a series of parallel universes, in this special blend of precision and puzzle platforming. Avoid horrifying enemies, collect magical glyphs, and discover the connection between Lily and the parallel universes.

![](https://img.itch.zone/aW1nLzgxODQ0MzAucG5n/original/brhU4P.png)

ParaLily is one little girl’s adventure to retrieve her dear stuffed dinosaur Patches, who in the middle of the night sprung to life and took off through a mysterious door. This strange journey will take Lily through a set of dangerous and terrifying parallel universes, as she attempts to retrieve her little stuffed runaway. Lily can shift between the parallel universes at will; which will help her avoid danger, and solve puzzles while traversing the paranormal universes.

This first chapter sets the tone for the journey ahead.
Solve each puzzle. Find Patches!

## Game Features

- Familiar platforming and side-scrolling action.

- Hand-drawn environments, characters, and animations.

- Innovative parallel universe shifting mechanics.

- Collectibles, puzzles, and hidden pathways.

- Creative multi-layered level designs.

## Parallel Universes

Each universe has is its own space with unique themes, enemies, and attributes. A single level cannot be traversed by only interacting with one universe, so the relative spatial relationship of each universe is critical to gameplay. When Lily changes universes her momentum carries with her, allowing her to continue a jump from one universe to the next. This combination of parallaxing parallel universes, and momentum; creates a special blend of precision and puzzle platforming, that makes ParaLily both challenging and thoughtful.

Also available on [Steam](https://store.steampowered.com/app/1156760/ParaLily/) and the [Nintendo Switch](https://www.nintendo.com/store/products/paralily-switch/).

![](https://img.itch.zone/aW1nLzgxODQ0MzkucG5n/original/0hjAKC.png)

internshipProjects.title: Coppervalle Rush
internshipProjects.shortDescription: Fast-paced 2D minecart platformer full of hazards, upgrades, humor, and heart.
internshipProjects.descriptionMd:
Hop in, hang on, and hold your hat — the mines are calling!

Play as Otis, a grizzled-but-gold-hearted retired miner who’s definitely too old for this, as he jumps back into the runaway minecart of life, to rescue his missing daughter, Jade. She’s ventured deep into the twisting, dangerous Coppervalle Mines without him — and now it’s up to Otis to brave collapsing tunnels, lava-filled caverns, and more in this fast-paced, side-scrolling platformer.

**Features:**

_Non-Stop Minecart Mayhem_

Blast through six handcrafted levels, from sun-scorched deserts to glittering diamond caverns to molten lava infernos — all without ever stopping. The minecart waits for no one.

_Tools of the Trade_

Jump over deadly gaps, duck under hazards, and wield your trusty slingshot to shatter rocks and shoo away pesky bats. Upgrade your gear between levels to last just a little longer next time...

_Bangers for Every Biome_

Each level features its own unique soundtrack — from toe-tapping to tension-raising, the music sets the mood as you rocket through the mines.

_Collect, Upgrade, Survive_

Grab hearts for health, shields for protection, and glowing monocles to expand your field of view. The deeper you go, the tougher it gets.

_Multiple Game Modes_

_Story Mode_: Rescue Jade and uncover the secrets of Coppervalle through six increasingly wild levels.

_FreePlay Mode_: Choose your favorite level and ride like the wind.

_Endless Mode_: Test your reflexes and see how long you can last as the speed — and the stakes — crank up!

_Play Your Way_

Supports keyboard & mouse or controllers. Whether you're a precision-jumper or a casual ore collector, there’s a cart with your name on it.

Coppervalle Rush is fast, funny, and full of frantic energy. So, gear up, crack a joke, and dive headfirst into a minecart ride you won’t forget. Just remember... avoid the fog.

**Controls:**

- Space - Jump
- Left Shift - Crouch
- LMB - Shoot (hold and drag)
- RMB - Use Monocle
- Escape - Pause

Developed by 3 of our interns during our Summer 2025 internship program!

internshipProjects.title: RAILBOUND
internshipProjects.shortDescription: RAILBOUND is a fast-paced 2D rogue-like indie game.
internshipProjects.descriptionMd:
**T****he World of RAILBOUND**

  Across distant colonies, sprawling industrial railways cut through the barren frontier, linking isolated cities, mining facilities, and forgotten settlements. Once a life filled with civilization…. has now ended abruptly.  These trains now carry more than passengers and supplies; trains now carry the weight of survival.  Steel cars groan under the strain of long journeys, cargo holds rattle with fragile remnants of industry, and dining compartments sit empty, haunted by the echoes of lives that have long since vanished.    Through wide, grime-streaked windows, travelers catch glimpses of a world scarred by neglect and decay, where twisted metal, abandoned outposts, and wasteland horizons stretch as far as the eye can see.

But the rails have grown deadly. A Dangerous world has become infested with a creeping, alien symbiote that now prowls the train lines, infecting everything it touches and turning ordinary journeys into relentless tests of skill and courage. Each railcar may conceal monstrous forms, unseen traps, and the remnants of those who came before.  Survival is no longer based on the quick, the cunning; only the ruthless will survive.

Into this nightmare steps Veronica, an operative of the RailBound Response Division (RRD). Her mission: exterminate the infestation and make it to Haven, the steel city looming faintly on the horizon.  Every railcar is a crucible; every step forward is a gamble with death. The train barrels relentlessly through the wasteland, and with every passing mile, the line between life and death grows ever thinner.

  RAILBOUND is a fast-paced 2D rogue-like indie game.  Every ride is a test of skill, reflexes, and strategize as you battle through treacherous railcars, each filled with deadly traps and relentless enemies. No two runs are ever the same—procedurally generated levels ensure that danger lurks around every corner, keeping you on your toes from the first car to the final car.

As the last hope for survival, you must choose your path wisely. Will you risk dangerous railcars for valuable resources, or play it safe and focus on survival?

• Upgrade your weapons and abilities between runs, crafting a unique arsenal to suit your playstyle. From swinging melee attacks to explosive firearms, every weapon can be enhanced, customized, and mastered to dominate the ever-changing threats of the train.

• Master your movement to survive the relentless onslaught: dash to evade attacks, parry to turn enemy strikes against them, wall jump to reach unreachable platforms and slide down walls to control your descent. Combat is fluid, rewarding skillful timing, precision, and strategic thinking.

Every ride through RAILBOUND is a story of survival, testing your reflexes and decision-making. Will you conquer the rails, uncover hidden secrets, and outlast the wasteland—or will the abandoned train become your tomb? With high replay ability, challenging enemies, and emergent gameplay, each run offers a new and thrilling experience for rogue-like enthusiasts and action gamers alike.

Features:

• Procedurally generated levels that ensure no two runs are alike

• Fast-paced combat with parry, dash, wall jump, and wall slide mechanics

• Upgradeable weapons and abilities to suit your strategy

• Dynamic railcars filled with hazards, enemies, and secret rewards

• High replay ability with endless challenges and evolving difficulty

Gameplay Mechanics:

• Parry: Time your attacks perfectly to deflect enemy strikes, opening them up for a counterattack.

• Dash: Quickly close the gap or evade enemy attacks with a burst of speed.

• Wall Jump: Scale walls to reach higher platforms or avoid deadly traps.

• Wall Slide: Slide down walls to control your descent and prepare for precise jumps.

• Weapon Upgrades: Collect scrap and resources to enhance your arsenal, making each run unique.

• Generated Levels: Each train ride is different, with random layouts, enemies, and hazards.

**RAILBOUND Controls**

Keyboard & Mouse:

• Move: W / A / S / D

• Jump: Space Bar

• Dash: Shift

• Parry: Q

• Attack: Left Mouse Button

Controller (Xbox / PlayStation style):

• Move: Left Stick or D-pad

• Jump: A (Xbox) / Cross (PS)

• Dash: B (Xbox) / Circle (PS)

• Parry: Y (Xbox) / Triangle (PS)

• Attack: X (Xbox) / Square (PS)

Systems & Extras

• Achievements to unlock as you progress levels

• Full Controller Support

**How to Play:**

• Navigate the Train: Move between railcars, jumping, dashing, and wall-jumping to traverse platforms and avoid traps.

• Engage Enemies: Use your weapons and abilities strategically—parry to turn the tide, dash to reposition, and chain combos to clear enemies.

• Collect and Upgrade: Gather resources to upgrade weapons and abilities, adapting to the evolving dangers of the train.

• Choose Your Path: Some railcars offer safer routes, others more rewards—but greater risk. Decide if you’ll gamble for loot or play it safe.

• Survive the Ride: Every run tests your skill and reflexes. Master movement, timing, and combat to reach the end of the train… if you can.

Prepare yourself for a ride where survival is never guaranteed. The train is moving, the wasteland is waiting, and every choice could be your last. Welcome to RAILBOUND.

Developed by 5 of our interns during our Spring 2026 internship program!

internshipProjects.title: On the Rocks
internshipProjects.shortDescription: Work to make ends meet as a cashier at a rundown liquor store.
internshipProjects.descriptionMd:
Welcome to _On the Rocks, _a 3D cashier simulation game where making it through the week means making every shift count.

Take your place behind the counter of a rundown liquor store and serve a cast of strange and unique customers. Scan their purchases, inspect their identification, look for suspicious information, and decide whether they should walk away with their order. Stay alert, though, as some customers may have more in mind than simply buying a drink.

Every decision matters during your shift. Follow policy guidelines and handle customers, catch fake IDs, and keep the line moving to maintain your performance throughout each shift. Mistakes can cost you your job, while careful and quick reactions can boost your shift rank.

Complete your shifts, track your progress, and prove that you have what it takes to keep your life together. When you’re working to make ends meet, losing your job isn’t an option.

Developed by 6 of our student interns from Wilmington University, Harrisburg University, George Mason University, and Old Dominion University during our Summer 2026 internship program!

jeremyProjects.title: Rowan of Bramblebrook
jeremyProjects.shortDescription: Seven days to make a home. One fateful night to save it.
jeremyProjects.descriptionMd:
# Download the Windows version to enjoy the full working experience including two unique endings!!

# ROWAN OF BRAMBLEBROOK

**Seven days. Seven stars. Seven bells. One unforgettable adventure.**

Welcome to Bramblebrook, a whimsical fantasy village where friendships blossom, romance awaits, and an ancient danger lurks beyond the forest.

After a spectacularly disastrous wagon ride through a raging storm, Rowan arrives in Bramblebrook hoping to begin a new life.

Explore a beautiful fantasy world, meet its eccentric residents, run a little shop, fall in love, and discover what makes this village special.

But something is coming.

**And on the seventh day, everything changes.**

## THE ADVENTURE

A love letter to classic PlayStation-era fantasy adventures, Rowan of Bramblebrook blends cozy village life with exploration, platforming, storytelling, and exciting action combat.

**Features:**

- A colorful, interconnected fantasy world to explore.
- A lively village filled with characters, conversations, and relationships.
- Shops, commerce, collectibles, and secrets.
- Romance, marriage, and cinematic story moments.
- Swords, magical creatures, and dangerous enemies.
- Dynamic weather, beautiful day/night transitions, and atmospheric fantasy music.
- An enormous, cinematic three-phase dragon boss battle.
- Multiple endings determined by your decisions.
- Retro PS1-inspired visuals with modern gameplay systems.

## LUCKY NUMBER: SEVEN

Created for the **Official Unity Game Jam 2026**, themed _Lucky Number_.

Seven days lead to a fateful confrontation. Seven stars carry an ancient legend. Seven bells herald the opportunity to change Bramblebrook's destiny.

Will seven be your lucky number?

**Or will the village pay the price?**

## HOW TO PLAY

**Keyboard and Mouse**

- WASD — Move
- Mouse (hold right button) — Camera
- Space — Jump
- E — Interact / Talk
- Tab / Escape — Daybook / Pause
- R — Draw / Sheath Sword
- Left Mouse — Light Attack
- Q — Heavy / Charged Attack
- F — Guard / Timed Parry
- Left Alt — Dodge
- H — Heal with Bread
- Hold Escape — Skip Cinematics

**Controller support**

Xbox and PlayStation-style controller layouts are supported, including movement, combat, interaction, and menus.

**Tips:** Speak with the villagers, visit Mara for weapons and supplies, and sleep in Rowan's bed to advance the day. Explore freely, make friends, and prepare yourself for whatever the seventh day brings.

## CREATED BY

**Jeremy Bregermann**

**Luna Wolf Studios LLC**

Game design, direction, narrative, gameplay programming, world building, combat, cinematics, UI/UX, production and quality assurance.

Built with Unity 6.

## ASSET CREDITS

This game uses original development work alongside licensed assets and tools from:

Tidal Flask Studios, Synty Studios, polyperfect, MalberS Animations, Meshtint Studio, BoZo, PLAYER TWO, Kevin Iglesias, MoCap Central, Pixel Crushers, Pathiral, NOT_Lonely, Digital Ruby, Unruly Games, PONETI, Valerie Moza, Daniel Ilett, NWH Coding, Demigiant, James Newton-King, Cafofo, Epic Sounds and FX, Imphenzia, AD Sounds, Joel Kent / Audimus Music, Gabriele Gilodi / Heart State Games, Mushra Games, Maxstack, Intersonic Sound, takareads, jsbarrett, Natanael Gama, Milena Brandao, Google, Red Hat, and Unity Technologies.

Full asset and licensing information is included in the game's credits and accompanying attribution documentation.

Development was assisted by OpenAI ChatGPT and Codex, including programming, narrative and dialogue work, and audio synthesis tooling. AI-assisted content is disclosed separately in the project's AI declaration.

**Thank you for playing Rowan of Bramblebrook!**

We hope you enjoy your time in our little corner of the fantasy world.

_Made with love by Jeremy Bregermann._
